First, we evaluate the inner integral by integrating with respect to $y$, treating $x$ as a constant:  

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{-1}^{1}[{\int }_{1}^{2}(x+{y}^{2})\,\text{d}y]\text{d}x & ={\int }_{-1}^{1}\,{[xy+\frac{{y}^{3}}{3}]}_{1}^{2}\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{-1}^{1}[(2x+\frac{8}{3})-(x+\frac{1}{3})]\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{-1}^{1}(x+\frac{7}{3})\,\text{d}x\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we integrate with respect to $x:$ 

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{-1}^{1}(x+\frac{7}{3})\,\text{d}x & ={[\frac{{x}^{2}}{2}+\frac{7x}{3}]}_{-1}^{1} \\  & =(\frac{1}{2}+\frac{7}{3})-(\frac{1}{2}-\frac{7}{3}) \\  & =\frac{14}{3}\end{aligned}
$$
